## Project Overview
This is a **Fitness Hub** website built with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Appwrite backend. The platform includes:

- **Workout Videos**: Video library with categorized fitness content
- **Workout Plans**: Structured fitness programs 
- **Diet Plans**: Nutrition guidance and meal planning
- **Personal Coaching**: Paid 1-on-1 coaching services with Stripe integration
- **Supplement Recommendations**: Product recommendations and affiliate links
- **Newsletter**: Email subscription functionality
- **Footwear**: Athletic footwear recommendations and shopping

## Technical Stack
- **Frontend**: Next.js 14 with App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- **Backend**: Appwrite (Database, Auth, Storage)
- **Payments**: Stripe for coaching subscriptions
- **Animations**: Framer Motion
- **Icons**: Lucide React

## Key Features
- **Admin Console**: Protected admin routes for content management
- **Real-time Updates**: Content automatically syncs from Appwrite
- **Responsive Design**: Mobile-first approach with Tailwind
- **Payment Integration**: Secure coaching payment processing
- **Media Management**: Video and image uploads via Appwrite Storage

## Code Guidelines
- Use TypeScript for all components and utilities
- Follow Next.js App Router conventions
- Implement server and client components appropriately
- Use Tailwind for all styling
- Create reusable UI components
- Implement proper error handling and loading states
- Follow responsive design principles
- Ensure accessibility standards
